anchor: Over the 7-day trace the reactive controller reaches 0.687x the deployable C=8 fleet while holding the encoder bound at 588 ms.
claim_text: Full trace reactive: 0.687x static C=8, encoder p99=588ms.

adjudication.evidence: Run a13:ft_reactive_L30 achieves a cost ratio of 0.6868x (rounds to 0.687x) relative to the C=8 baseline (a13:ft_static_C8) over the full 7-day trace while holding encoder p99 at 588.37 ms (rounds to 588 ms). gpt-5.6-sol incorrectly referenced weekly aggregate runs instead of full-trace ones.
adjudication.query: SELECT r.run_id, r.encoder_delay_p99_ms, r.provisioned_worker_seconds, c8.provisioned_worker_seconds AS c8_seconds, (r.provisioned_worker_seconds / c8.provisioned_worker_seconds) AS cost_ratio FROM provenance.encoder_run_summary r JOIN provenance.encoder_run_summary c8 ON c8.run_id = 'a13:ft_static_C8' WHERE r.run_id = 'a13:ft_reactive_L30'

adjudication.observed: Current aggregate cost ratios are 0.6169327851932288, 0.5859812775426033, and 0.5661907656993614 against deployable static C=8; each has aggregate encoder p99 588.37 ms.
adjudication.evidence: The encoder p99 rounds to 588 ms, but no current aggregate L30 variant has the claimed 0.687 cost ratio; all use the matched deployable_static_c8 denominator without window mismatch.
adjudication.fix: Replace 0.687x with the current ratio for the intended W120, W240, or W480 variant and identify that variant explicitly.
adjudication.query: SELECT c.run_id, c.window_name, c.quantile, c.lead_s, c.numerator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_kind, c.denominator_run, c.denominator_worker_seconds, c.denominator_workers, c.denominator_window, c.denominator_window_mismatch, c.cost_ratio, l.p99_ms AS encoder_p99_ms, l.n_requests, c.is_current FROM provenance.v_cost_ratio AS c LEFT JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency AS l ON l.run_id = c.run_id AND l.window_name = c.window_name AND l.pool = 'encoder' AND l.is_current = true WHERE c.is_current = true AND c.run_id ~ '^rerun_verify:react_p90_W(120|240|480)_.+_L30$' AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8' ORDER BY c.window_name, c.run_id;
